source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    mov.MovieIdNK,
    mov.Title,
    mov.ReleaseDate,
    mov.Runtime,
    stat.MovieStatusName,
    GETUTCDATE() AS CreatedDate,
    GETUTCDATE() AS ModifiedDate
FROM dbo.tMovies AS mov
INNER JOIN dbo.tMovieStatus AS stat
    ON mov.MovieStatusId = stat.MovieStatusId;

SELECT
    ServiceCode,
    ServiceName,
    GETUTCDATE() AS CreatedDate,
    GETUTCDATE() AS ModifiedDate
FROM dbo.tOnlineService;

SELECT
    year(prch.TransactionDate)*10000 + month(prch.TransactionDate)*100 + day(prch.TransactionDate) AS DateKey,
    dim_srvc.ServiceKey AS OnlineServiceKey,
    dim_mov.MovieKey,
    prch.Price,
    prch.TransactionId
FROM dbo.tOnlinePurchase AS prch
INNER JOIN dbo.tOnlineService AS srvc
    ON prch.ServiceId = srvc.ServiceId
INNER JOIN dbo.DataMart_DimOnlineService AS dim_srvc
    ON srvc.ServiceName = dim_srvc.ServiceName
INNER JOIN dbo.tMovies AS mov
    ON prch.MovieId = mov.MovieId
INNER JOIN dbo.DataMart_DimMovie AS dim_mov
    ON mov.MovieIdNK = dim_mov.MovieIdNK;

WITH CTE_AllSales AS (   
    SELECT
        year(prch.TransactionDate)*10000 + month(prch.TransactionDate)*100 AS MonthKey,
        dim_srvc.ServiceKey AS OnlineServiceKey,
        prch.Price,
        prch.TransactionId
    FROM dbo.tOnlinePurchase AS prch
    INNER JOIN dbo.tOnlineService AS srvc
        ON prch.ServiceId = srvc.ServiceId
    INNER JOIN dbo.DataMart_DimOnlineService AS dim_srvc
        ON srvc.ServiceName = dim_srvc.ServiceName
)
SELECT
    MonthKey,
    OnlineServiceKey,
    SUM(Price) AS PurchaseAmount,
    COUNT(Price) AS PurchaseQuantity
FROM CTE_AllSales
GROUP BY MonthKey, OnlineServiceKey;
